<template>
  <el-dialog title="添加防火墙规则" v-model="dialogVisible" width="600px">
    <el-form label-width="100px">
      <!-- 容器选择 -->
      <el-form-item label="选择容器">
        <el-select v-model="selectedContainer" placeholder="请选择容器">
          <el-option
              v-for="(container, index) in containers"
              :key="index"
              :label="container.name.replace(/^\//, '')"
              :value="container.name.replace(/^\//, '')"
          />
        </el-select>
      </el-form-item>

      <!-- 链选择 -->
      <el-form-item label="选择链">
        <el-select v-model="selectedChain" placeholder="请选择链">
          <el-option label="INPUT" value="INPUT" />
          <el-option label="OUTPUT" value="OUTPUT" />
          <el-option label="FORWARD" value="FORWARD" />
        </el-select>
      </el-form-item>

      <!-- 规则输入 -->
      <el-form-item label="规则内容">
        <el-input v-model="rule" placeholder="请输入防火墙规则" />
      </el-form-item>
    </el-form>

    <template #footer>
      <el-button type="primary" @click="handleAddRule" :loading="loading">添加规则</el-button>
      <el-button @click="dialogVisible = false" :disabled="loading">取消</el-button>
    </template>

    <!-- 获取容器列表 -->
    <DockerContainers ref="containersRef" />
  </el-dialog>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, nextTick, defineExpose } from 'vue'
import axios from 'axios'
import { ElMessage } from 'element-plus'
import DockerContainers from '@/components/Container/DockerContainers.vue'

const dialogVisible = ref(false) // 弹窗可见性
const containers = ref([]) // 容器列表
const selectedContainer = ref('') // 选中的容器
const selectedChain = ref('INPUT') // 选中的链
const rule = ref('') // 输入的规则
const loading = ref(false) // 按钮加载状态

const containersRef = ref(null) // 引用容器组件

// 打开弹窗并获取容器列表
const openDialog = async () => {
  dialogVisible.value = true
  await nextTick()
  if (containersRef.value) {
    await containersRef.value.fetchContainers()
    containers.value = containersRef.value.containers || []
  }
}

// 处理添加防火墙规则
const handleAddRule = async () => {
  if (!selectedContainer.value || !rule.value) {
    ElMessage.warning('请选择容器并输入规则')
    return
  }

  loading.value = true

  try {
    await axios.post(`http://localhost:8081/firewall/add`, {
      containerName: selectedContainer.value,
      chain: selectedChain.value,
      rule: rule.value
    })
    ElMessage.success('防火墙规则添加成功')
    dialogVisible.value = false
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('添加规则失败', err)
    ElMessage.error('添加规则失败')
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}

defineExpose({ openDialog }) // 暴露openDialog方法
</script>

<style scoped>
</style>
